rows.grounds: compound tattva plus mudrā in accusative singular
gerund pradarśya plus atha fused in one surface token
demonstrative idam with anna-amṛta compound in accusative singular
optative of root vad in third person singular

items.question: What should be said after showing the tattva-mudrā in this Kaula food-rite?
items.inference: the rite prescribes saying this food-nectar after displaying the tattva-mudrā
uncertainties: exact referent of tattva-mudrā is not specified
whether annāmṛta is literal or symbolic is not specified
items.plain_english: Having shown the tattva-mudrā, one should then say, 'This is the food-nectar.'
